name: benchmark_v2
description: Frozen benchmark of oshd 1.0.0: the trajectories and train / test split of Hub revision df3530b (6413 simulated + 92 real trajectories). Simulated: per recording run, ~20% of the runs of each scenario config in test (configs with few runs can be train only). Real: the trajectories with a target model (CubeSat 007-009, mockups antena 010-039 and antena_1_solar 040-098), per lighting setting (target, light colour temperature, intensity): whole settings in test, ~20% of each target's trajectories; 007-009 keep their benchmark_v1 split. Target CAD (models/sim/, models/real/, models/objects.yaml) and calibration are at the same revision. Never changes; later data goes into new benchmark versions.
